_comment: ADM Task Scheduler entries for NAS backup infrastructure. These are user-defined scheduled tasks in ADM. Import via Control Panel → Task Scheduler → Add → Scheduled Task → User-defined script. Or recreate manually with the schedule and script paths below.

tasks.name: NAS: pull vzdump from Proxmox nodes
tasks.notes: Runs nightly at 02:30. Proxmox's built-in vzdump schedule runs at 02:00, so 02:30 gives it time to complete. Adjust if your vzdump schedule differs.

tasks.name: NAS: restic backup
tasks.notes: Runs nightly at 03:30, after pull-vzdump.sh completes. Backs up /volume1/backup-primary/vzdump-staging/ to the restic repo with --keep-daily 7 --keep-weekly 4 --keep-monthly 3 retention.

tasks.name: NAS: restic replicate to Volume 2
tasks.notes: Runs nightly at 05:00, after restic-backup.sh. Uses 'restic copy' to deduplicate the snapshot history from Volume 1 to Volume 2.

tasks.name: NAS: restic check (weekly integrity)
tasks.notes: Runs Sundays at 03:00. Validates the entire restic repo for bitrot and corruption. Catches problems before you need to restore.

proxmox_side.comment: Proxmox-side vzdump schedule. Set this in Proxmox's web UI at Datacenter → Backup → Add. Once set, the Proxmox node runs vzdump locally to /var/lib/vz/dump/. The NAS then pulls those files via pull-vzdump.sh.
proxmox_side.notes: Set this on BOTH Proxmox nodes (Acer Nitro 10.0.100.10 and HP Omen 10.0.100.137). Email notification is set to 'none' because the NAS-side matrix-monitor-backups.sh is the source of truth for backup success/failure.

felix_side.comment: Felix-side cron entry for matrix-monitor-backups.sh. Install on Felix (not the NAS).
felix_side.notes: Runs every 6 hours. Watches /mnt/nas-backup-primary (NFS-mounted) for backup freshness. Posts to the Matrix alert room if any node's backup is older than 26 hours. Requires /mnt/nas-backup-primary to be mounted — see setup-guide.md Phase 11 for the /etc/fstab entry.
